m07_77.say: Welcome to today's workshop on applying Statistical Process Control, or SPC, charts on the shop floor. Many new quality technicians get nervous whenever they see a data point cross the upper or lower control limit. Remember: a single point outside the control limits doesn't automatically mean we scrap the entire lot. First, we verify whether there was a measurement error, a miscalibrated gauge, or an assignable cause like a worn cutting insert. Before we head out to the shop floor, let's break into small groups of four. Each group will receive a sample dataset from Line 3 to plot and identify any out-of-control trends.

m07_89.say: Welcome back to Supply Chain Weekly. Today we're talking about one of the biggest vulnerabilities in modern manufacturing: single-source risk. Too often, procurement teams lock into a single supplier for a critical component just to squeeze out an extra three percent volume discount. My advice? Avoid relying on one vendor for any part that could halt your main assembly line. Just look at what happened last year to a mid-sized automotive supplier in central Taiwan: a fire broke out at their sole casting vendor's foundry, shutting down the automaker's entire transmission line for four weeks because no backup supplier had been pre-qualified. Always qualify at least a secondary source for Tier-1 parts.

When bearing vibration levels deviate by more than 12 percent from baseline, the system automatically generates a work order in the maintenance queue and reserves the required replacement kit in the parts crib. SECTION 4.2: SUPPLIER CORRECTIVE ACTION REQUEST PROCEDURE

When an incoming lot fails receiving inspection or causes a line stoppage at our facility, the Quality Assurance (QA) department will issue a formal Supplier Corrective Action Request within 24 business hours. — [1] —. Upon receipt of a corrective action request, the supplier must acknowledge the notice and implement immediate containment actions—such as 100% sorting of inventory in transit and at the supplier's warehouse—within two business days.

Within ten business days of corrective action request issuance, the supplier is required to submit a formal root-cause report detailing the verified root cause, permanent corrective actions, and preventive measures to avoid recurrence across similar product lines. — [2] —. Simply citing "operator error" or "retraining staff" without systemic process controls (e.g., error-proofing fixtures or automated sensors) will result in automatic rejection of the root-cause report.

• 誘答分析：(B) 重複字 "schedule / month"；(A) 重複字 "vendor" 加上 Yes/No 陷阱。

questions.q: What problem are the speakers discussing?
options: An overnight courier lost a shipment of valves.
Assembly Line 4 was shut down for a client audit.
Reserve stock on Shelf B has run out.
Some incoming components did not meet testing standards.

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨與問題確認（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士問進料壓力閥門（incoming batch of precision pressure valves）狀況，女士說將近 15% 未通過保壓測試（failed the pressure-retention inspection），選項 (D) "Some incoming components did not meet testing standards." 以「部分進料零件未達測試標準」同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 重複原文 "overnight courier" 與 "valves"，但並非包裹遺失；(B) 重複 "Assembly Line 4" 與 "client audit"，但他們是要避免產線停擺；(C) 重複 "reserve stock on Shelf B"，但備品尚未耗盡。

questions.q: What does the woman say she will do next?
options: Move the reserve stock from Shelf B to Line 4
Postpone the major client audit until tomorrow
Request an urgent replacement shipment from the supplier
Re-test the valves that failed the retention check

explain.text:
• 考點：說話者接下來行動（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士說 "I'm going to call the vendor right now to demand an immediate replacement order via overnight courier."，選項 (C) "Request an urgent replacement shipment from the supplier" 將 vendor 換為 supplier、immediate replacement order 換為 urgent replacement shipment。
• 誘答分析：(A) 原文是從 Shelf B 取備品給 Line 4，但這是雙方後續配套而非女士立刻要打電話的事，且她說的是聯繫廠商；(B) 原文只說明天早上有客戶稽核，並未說要延期；(D) 原文已測試完成，未說要重測。

questions.q: When is the client audit scheduled to take place?
options: In two days
At the end of the week
The following morning
Later this afternoon

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（時間同義替換）。
• 解析：男士說 "tomorrow morning"，選項 (C) "The following morning" 為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A)(B) 皆為時間錯置干擾項。

questions.q: Why is the man calling the procurement department?
options: To report that a packaging line has stopped running
To submit a new requisition for a backup motor
To ask when the finance director returns from Taipei
To inquire about the progress of an equipment request

explain.text:
• 考點：來電目的題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士說他送出兩個電動馬達的請購單，打來確認核准進度（check on its approval status），選項 (D) "To inquire about the progress of an equipment request" 將 check on status 換為 inquire about the progress、purchase requisition 換為 equipment request。
• 誘答分析：(B) 重複 "backup motor"，但那是產線目前暫用的備用馬達而非新請購；(C) 重複 "finance director" 與 "Taipei"，但非主要來電目的；(A) 重複 "packaging line"，但產線目前仍靠備用馬達運轉中，並未停機。

questions.q: What does the woman imply when she says, "The finance director is attending the Taipei trade expo until Thursday"?
options: Requisitions under ten thousand dollars are also on hold.
Final authorization for the purchase will be delayed.
The vendor comparison sheet will be presented at the expo.
The man should send the engineering review to Taipei.

explain.text:
• 考點：言外之意推論題（同義替換）。
• 解析：財務總監要到週四才從台北貿易展回來，而超過一萬美元的請購單需要她最終簽核，因此暗指 (B)「採購的最終授權將會延遲（Final authorization for the purchase will be delayed.）」。
• 誘答分析：(D) 重複 "engineering review" 與 "Taipei"，但工程審核已經通過，無須寄去台北；(A) 過度推論，原文僅說「超過一萬美元」需財務總監簽核；(C) 重複 "vendor comparison sheet" 與 "expo"，但比價表是回來後加速審核用的，並非要在展會簡報。

questions.q: What does the woman suggest the man do in the meantime?
options: Wait until Thursday to submit the requisition number
Switch the packaging line to a backup motor
Organize a side-by-side summary of supplier bids
Request an expedited engineering review

explain.text:
• 考點：建議事項（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士建議 "prepare the vendor comparison sheet"，選項 (C) "Organize a side-by-side summary of supplier bids" 將 vendor comparison sheet 改寫為「整理供應商報價的並列摘要」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 重複 "packaging line" 與 "backup motor"，但產線已經在使用備用馬達；(D) 重複 "engineering review"，但工程審核已通過；(A) 重複 "Thursday" 與 "requisition number"，但請購單四天前就已送出。

questions.q: Where most likely does this conversation take place?
options: At a safety supplier's showroom
In a municipal inspector's office
In a metal-stamping manufacturing area
Inside a maintenance portal room

explain.text:
• 考點：對話地點推論（上位概念／同義替換）。
• 解析：女士剛在 "metal press floor"（金屬沖壓車間）結束突襲安全巡檢，選項 (C) "In a metal-stamping manufacturing area" 以同義詞改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 重複 "safety supplier"，但那是之後要叫貨的廠商；(B) 重複 "municipal" 與 "inspector"，但稽查員是來廠內巡檢；(D) 重複 "portal"，但那是電腦系統而非地點。

questions.q: What safety violation did the inspector point out?
options: Staff failed to log a corrective action in the portal.
Hearing-safety notices were worn out and hard to read.
Workers near Press #6 were not wearing ear protection.
Clear aisles were blocked by older equipment.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：稽查員指出 "the ear-protection warning signage near Press #6 was severely faded and barely legible"，選項 (B) "Hearing-safety notices were worn out and hard to read." 將 ear-protection warning signage 換為 hearing-safety notices、faded and barely legible 換為 worn out and hard to read。
• 誘答分析：(D) 原文 M1 說「一直努力保持走道淨空」，女士也稱讚內務管理很好，並非違規項目；(A) 原文 M1 說「會立刻在系統登錄矯正行動」，並非缺失；(C) 重複 "Press #6" 與 "ear protection"，但違規的是標示牌褪色而非工人沒戴護具。

questions.q: What will the third speaker (Kenji) be responsible for?
options: Logging the corrective action in the safety portal
Escorting the municipal inspector around the floor
Removing the faded placards from Press #6
Purchasing durable replacement signs

explain.text:
• 考點：三人對話人物分工（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士請 Kenji 訂購一組十張耐候型高對比標示牌（order a set of ten weatherproof placards），選項 (D) "Purchasing durable replacement signs" 將 order 換為 purchasing、weatherproof 換為 durable、placards 換為 signs。
• 誘答分析：(A) 這是 M1 要負責的事（張冠李戴陷阱）；(B) 巡檢已經結束（wrapped up）；(C) 重複 "faded placards" 與 "Press #6"，但原文是訂新牌子替換全區舊牌。

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: Getting CFO approval for a thirty-thousand-dollar bonus
Clearing the Q4 backlog by adding an extra shift
Upgrading an outdated piece of molding equipment
Reducing the cycle time of their current 200-ton unit

explain.text:
• 考點：對話主旨（同義替換）。
• 解析：兩人討論汰換老舊 200 噸射出成型機的提案（replacing our aging 200-ton injection molding machine），選項 (C) "Upgrading an outdated piece of molding equipment" 將 replacing aging 換為 upgrading outdated、machine 換為 equipment。
• 誘答分析：(B) 重複 "Q4 backlog"，但原文是要靠新機台而非加班清積壓訂單；(A) 重複 "CFO" 與 "thirty thousand dollars"，但該金額是超支的資本支出而非獎金；(D) 重複 "cycle time" 與 "200-ton unit"，但縮短週期的是新機型 Apex-900 而非舊機。

questions.q: According to the woman, what is the main advantage of the Apex-900 model?
options: It operates significantly faster per production cycle.
It requires no CFO sign-off before issuing a PO.
It fits within the existing Q4 equipment budget.
It eliminates the need for electric-drive maintenance.

explain.text:
• 考點：優勢細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士說新機的電動驅動系統將週期時間縮短近 20%（cuts cycle time by nearly twenty percent），選項 (A) "It operates significantly faster per production cycle." 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B) 皆重複原文 "Q4 equipment budget"、"CFO sign-off" 與 "PO"，但剛好與原文事實相反（超支且需要簽核）；(D) 重複 "electric-drive"，但原文未提免保養。

questions.q: What concern does the man raise?
options: The electric-drive system has not been tested.
The initial purchase price goes beyond allocated funds.
The CFO is unlikely to review the summary this morning.
The Q4 backlog cannot be cleared in time.

explain.text:
• 考點：顧慮細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士擔心 "the upfront capital expenditure exceeds our Q4 equipment budget"，選項 (B) "The initial purchase price goes beyond allocated funds." 將 upfront capital expenditure 換為 initial purchase price、exceeds budget 換為 goes beyond allocated funds。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A)(C) 皆抓取原文 "Q4 backlog"、"electric-drive system"、"CFO / summary this morning" 等關鍵字進行過度推論或時間錯置。

questions.q: Why are the speakers reviewing the calibration schedule?
options: An upcoming quality evaluation is two weeks away.
Plant 2 requested calibration records for its lab.
Several instruments were marked inactive on the tracker.
An external technician just arrived for an audit.

explain.text:
• 考點：對話目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士提到 "with the quality standard audit coming up in two weeks"，選項 (A) "An upcoming quality evaluation is two weeks away." 將 audit 換為 evaluation。
• 誘答分析：(D) 重複 "external technician"，但該技師上週延期了，並非現在來稽核；(B) 重複 "Plant 2"，但二廠是之後用來支援量測的；(C) 重複 "tracker"，但多數儀器狀態為 Active 而非 Inactive。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which piece of equipment is the woman worried about?
options: PMM-01
OPT-04
TEN-02
XRF-07

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽音訊線索＋查表）。
• 解析：音訊中男士刻意不唸出機台編號，只問「11 月 12 日就該校準的那台（due on November 12）」，女士回答「我正擔心那台，已經逾期（already past its deadline）」。對照表格 Next Due Date 為 Nov 12 且 Status 為 Overdue 的機台即為 (A) PMM-01。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(D) 皆為表格上其他正常或已排程的機台。

questions.q: What do the speakers agree to do?
options: Have the optical surface profiler re-checked immediately
Transfer all metrology instruments to Plant 2
Disable the past-due unit until it is certified
Reschedule the quality audit for next Friday

explain.text:
• 考點：雙方共識（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士提議 "take that unit out of service immediately until the certification engineer arrives"，選項 (C) "Disable the past-due unit until it is certified" 將 take out of service 換為 disable、certification engineer arrives 換為 until it is certified。
• 誘答分析：(B) 原文只說將緊急量測轉至 Plant 2，而非搬移所有儀器；(D) 重複 "Friday"，但週五是認證工程師抵達日，稽核在兩週後；(A) 重複 "optical surface profiler"，但該儀器狀態正常無須重檢。

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to do?
options: Perform a composition check on sample hardware
Lock in next month's production supply by 5:00 P.M.
Update the software on the lab's testing device
Contact a new fastener supplier in Tainan

explain.text:
• 考點：請求事項（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士請女士下午檢查一批 M8 不鏽鋼扣件樣品以驗證合金成分（inspect them this afternoon to verify the alloy composition），選項 (A) "Perform a composition check on sample hardware" 將 fasteners 換為 hardware、inspect/verify 換為 perform a check。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 皆重複原文 "Tainan"、"software"、"testing device"、"lock in next month's supply by 5:00 P.M."，但分別屬於背景資訊、女士限制與生管部門的要求。

questions.q: What does the woman mean when she says, "Our testing device is still undergoing software updates"?
options: She is unable to run the analysis today.
IT will complete the test for her tomorrow.
The alloy composition has already been verified.
The sample lot from Tainan arrived too late.

explain.text:
• 考點：句意推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士說檢測儀器正在進行軟體更新，IT 說要到明天下午才會恢復上線，意即 (A)「她今天無法進行分析（She is unable to run the analysis today.）」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 重複 "IT" 與 "tomorrow"，但 IT 只負責更新軟體而非代為檢測；(D) 重複 "sample lot from Tainan"，但樣品已準時送達；(C) 重複 "alloy composition"，但尚未驗證。

questions.q: What will the man probably do next?
options: Arrange for an external facility to run urgent tests
Ask production planning to push back the 5:00 P.M. deadline
Wait until tomorrow afternoon to inspect the fasteners
Call IT to cancel the software update

explain.text:
• 考點：接下來行動預測（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士建議用快遞把幾顆樣品送到 SGS 或其他認可的第三方實驗室做當日分析（courier a few pieces over to SGS or another accredited third-party lab），選項 (A) "Arrange for an external facility to run urgent tests" 將 third-party lab 換為 external facility、same-day analysis 換為 urgent tests。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(D) 皆抓取原文 "5:00 P.M."、"tomorrow afternoon"、"IT / software update" 作為陷阱，但與急迫需求相違背。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the meeting?
options: To vote on a $90,000 maintenance budget for Warehouse B
To review filter maintenance logs from Vendor A
To negotiate a shorter six-week delivery schedule
To compare contractor proposals for air-system improvements

explain.text:
• 考點：會議目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：M1 開場說要審查升級 B 棟倉庫集塵與通風系統的三份標書（review the three bids ... for upgrading the dust-collection and ventilation system），選項 (D) "To compare contractor proposals for air-system improvements" 將 bids 換為 contractor proposals、ventilation upgrade 換為 air-system improvements。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(B) 皆重複原文 "$90,000"、"six weeks"、"filter maintenance"、"Vendor A"，但均非會議主要目的或將「尚未投票／六週交期」誤寫為已決議／要殺價。

questions.q: What does the woman say about Vendor B (AirFlow Solutions)?
options: Setup work is bundled into their quoted fee.
Their hardware price is lower than Vendor A's.
They can deliver the system in less than six weeks.
They charge extra for ductwork installation.

explain.text:
• 考點：特定對象細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士提到 AirFlow Solutions 的報價已免費包含現場安裝（includes full on-site installation in their quote at no additional charge），選項 (A) "Setup work is bundled into their quoted fee." 將 installation 換為 setup work、included at no additional charge 換為 bundled into quoted fee。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D) 將 Vendor A 與 Vendor B 的條件張冠李戴（硬體最低價與安裝另計皆為 Vendor A）；(C) 原文兩家交期都是六週。

questions.q: What do the speakers decide to request before making a final decision?
options: A committee vote scheduled for next Monday
Feedback from comparable industrial clients
A revised $90,000 quote from Vendor A
Updated technical sheets on filter maintenance

explain.text:
• 考點：團隊決定事項（同義替換）。
• 解析：兩人同意向 AirFlow Solutions 索取三家其他電子製造商的客戶推薦名單（request three client references from other electronics manufacturers），選項 (B) "Feedback from comparable industrial clients" 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(A) 皆抓取原文 "$90,000"、"technical sheets / filter maintenance"、"committee vote" 作為誘答陷阱。

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
options: Addressing production quality issues on board assembly lines
Replacing the 0.4-millimeter pitch chips on Line 1
Increasing paste volume during tomorrow's 50-board trial
Calculating the total number of boards shipped in Q3

explain.text:
• 考點：對話主旨（同義替換）。
• 解析：兩人檢討第三季電路板組裝線的退貨不良原因並提出對策，選項 (A) "Addressing production quality issues on board assembly lines" 為整體主旨改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(C) 皆重複原文 "Q3"、"0.4-millimeter pitch chips"、"Line 1"、"paste volume"、"50-board trial"，但均屬於局部細節的誤導改寫。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which issue will the engineering team prioritize first?
options: Inadequate Thermal Cure
Solder Bridging
Packaging Damage
Component Misalignment

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽音訊線索＋查表）。
• 解析：音訊中刻意不說出類別名稱，只說「最大單一類別佔了總失敗數的 40%（the largest single category accounted for 40 percent）」，且男士接著說「那個領先類別必須是本季首要工程優先項目（that leading category has to be our top engineering priority）」。對照圖表 40% 對應的項目為 (B) Solder Bridging（錫橋，也就是對話裡的 solder bridges）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 佔 25%（第二位）；(A) 佔 20%；(C) 佔 15%。

questions.q: What solution does the man propose?
options: Running a 50-board trial using the existing stencil
Reducing paste volume on the 25-percent failure group
Increasing the aperture width on all assembly lines
Testing a laser-cut template with narrower openings

explain.text:
• 考點：解決方案細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士提議改用開口較窄的雷射切割鋼板進行試產（switching to a laser-cut template with narrower openings），選項 (D) "Testing a laser-cut template with narrower openings" 對應其提議，而錯誤選項 (C)(A)(B) 則以原文的 "apertures too wide"、"50-board trial"、"paste volume"、"25-percent" 製造干擾。

questions.q: What happened at the loading bay earlier this morning?
options: Maintenance failed to service the leveler last month.
A piece of dock equipment broke down mid-operation.
A worker was injured while unloading sheet metal.
Incoming trucks blocked access to Loading Bay 2.

explain.text:
• 考點：事件經過（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士說裝卸碼頭升降平台在卸下鋼板棧板到一半時故障卡在升起位置（loading dock leveler malfunctioned halfway through unloading），選項 (B) "A piece of dock equipment broke down mid-operation." 將 leveler malfunctioned halfway 換為 dock equipment broke down mid-operation。
• 誘答分析：(C) 重複 "sheet metal"，但明確無人受傷；(D) 重複 "incoming trucks" 與 "Loading Bay 2"，但卡車只是被改道而非堵住入口；(A) 重複 "serviced just last month"，與事實相反。

questions.q: How does the woman react to the news?
options: She doubts that a technician will arrive before noon.
She is upset that Facilities rerouted the trucks to Bay 5.
She insists on inspecting the sheet-metal pallet herself.
She is puzzled given the unit's recent servicing.

explain.text:
• 考點：說話者情緒反應（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士得知後除了慶幸無人受傷，也說 "though it's still surprising—wasn't that unit serviced just last month?"，選項 (D) "She is puzzled given the unit's recent servicing." 將 surprising 換為 puzzled。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(C) 皆重複原文 "Facilities / Bay 5"、"technician"、"pallet" 等字眼，但捏造了原文沒有的負面情緒或動作。

questions.q: What does the man say is already underway?
options: Servicing the jammed leveler at Bay 2
Directing arriving freight vehicles to another bay
Unloading the remaining pallets at Bay 5
Scheduling a follow-up inspection with the maintenance lead

explain.text:
• 考點：現正進行中的措施（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士說設施組已經把所有進廠卡車改道至 5 號碼頭（Facilities is already rerouting all incoming trucks to Bay 5），選項 (B) "Directing arriving freight vehicles to another bay" 將 rerouting incoming trucks 換為 directing arriving freight vehicles。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(D) 皆重複原文 "Bay 2"、"Bay 5"、"maintenance lead"，但 Bay 2 目前是掛牌停用等技師抵達，並未開始維修。

questions.q: Who most likely is the woman?
options: A representative from a chemical distribution firm
A specialist overseeing regulatory safety standards
A manager reviewing yellow binder inventory
A technician working in the finishing department

explain.text:
• 考點：說話者身分推論（上位概念／同義替換）。
• 解析：女士自稱 "corporate environmental compliance officer"，前來做稽核前檢查並提醒法規標準更新，選項 (B) "A specialist overseeing regulatory safety standards" 為同義職稱改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(C) 皆重複原文 "chemical distributor"、"finishing department"、"yellow binders" 製造身分錯置陷阱。

questions.q: Why must the factory update its safety data sheets by Friday?
options: The chemical distributor changed its solvent formulas.
The yellow binders in the finishing department are full.
The pre-audit check uncovered missing PDF files.
Government rules on hazard labeling were updated.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士解釋因為危害標示的法規標準近期修訂（regulatory standards for hazard labeling were recently revised），選項 (D) "Government rules on hazard labeling were updated." 將 regulatory standards 換為 government rules、revised 換為 updated。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(C) 皆重複原文 "yellow binders"、"solvent"、"PDF files"、"pre-audit check"，但都不是週五前必須更新的原因。

questions.q: What does the man offer to do?
options: Email the updated GHS files to the woman by Friday
Move the yellow binders to the compliance office
Revise the hazard labels on every solvent drum
Reach out to the supplier to obtain current documents

explain.text:
• 考點：說話者主動提議（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士說他今天會聯繫化學品經銷商取得所有溶劑的最新 PDF 檔（contact our chemical distributor today to make sure we have the newest PDF files），選項 (D) "Reach out to the supplier to obtain current documents" 精準對應。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 皆重複原文 "yellow binders"、"hazard labels"、"GHS / Friday"，但都是自行延伸的錯誤動作。

questions.q: Why is the woman speaking with the man?
options: To resolve an incomplete shipment of safety gear
To confirm whether the $120 cartridges were ordered
To request an extra freight allowance on Line Item 02
To complain that the vendor never emailed an update

explain.text:
• 考點：對話目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士拿裝箱單核對安全護具採購單，發現數量不符（checking the packing slip against our purchase order for safety gear, and the numbers don't quite match），選項 (A) "To resolve an incomplete shipment of safety gear" 精準概括。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(D) 皆抓取原文 "freight"、"Line Item 02"、"$120"、"emailed" 進行語意扭曲。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which item has a quantity discrepancy?
options: Nitrile Work Gloves (Box)
Laser Safety Goggles
Anti-Static Wrist Straps
Air Filter Cartridges

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽音訊線索＋查表）。
• 解析：圖表僅列出訂購數量與單價，未直接顯示實收數量。音訊中女士指出「第 2 項——單價 $8.50 的品項，訂了 200 個但箱子裡只有 160 個」，對照表格 Line Item 02 / $8.50 即為 (C) Anti-Static Wrist Straps。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(D) 單價分別為 $45、$18、$120，男士明確表示這三項皆已全數到齊。

questions.q: What does the man say about the missing units?
options: They were omitted from the packing slip by mistake.
They will incur an additional freight charge on Tuesday.
They were shipped separately to another receiving bay.
They are temporarily out of stock and will arrive next week.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士說剩下的 40 條目前缺貨待補（backordered），下週二會寄出且不另收運費，選項 (D) "They are temporarily out of stock and will arrive next week." 將 backordered 換為 temporarily out of stock、next Tuesday 換為 next week。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(C) 皆重複原文 "packing slip"、"freight" 等字，但與事實相反（無額外運費）。

questions.q: What does the woman say about the safety lock procedure?
options: The junction panel was left unlocked during the day.
Night-shift supervisors approved a temporary shortcut.
A new acknowledgment form is needed for plant electricians.
Outside workers failed to follow the required steps.

explain.text:
• 考點：問題陳述（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士指出兩名臨時電氣外包人員昨晚未執行安全鎖驗證步驟（two temporary electrical contractors skipped the safety lock verification step），選項 (D) "Outside workers failed to follow the required steps." 將 temporary contractors 換為 outside workers、skipped 換為 failed to follow。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(C) 皆重複原文 "shift"、"junction panel"、"acknowledgment form"、"plant electricians"，但情節全錯。

questions.q: Why does the man mention the main electrical room?
options: High-voltage panels there are scheduled for maintenance.
The contracting firm's supervisor works in that area.
Entering it demands two separate locks for verification.
Two temporary contractors were injured inside it.

explain.text:
• 考點：提及特定事物目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士補充說明主電氣室需要特別的雙重上鎖驗證（requires a specialized dual-lock verification—both the contractor's lock and our plant electrician's lock），選項 (C) "Entering it demands two separate locks for verification." 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A)(B) 皆重複原文 "temporary contractors"、"high-voltage"、"contracting firm's supervisor"，但並非提及主電氣室的原因。

questions.q: What will the speakers do before the end of the day?
options: Dismiss the two temporary electrical contractors
Send an official compliance notice to the contractor's manager
Conduct an evening-shift walkthrough of the electrical room
Replace the locks on all high-voltage junction panels

explain.text:
• 考點：雙方接下來行動（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士提議下班前向包商工地主管發出正式書面安全指示（draft and issue a formal written safety directive to the contracting firm's site supervisor），選項 (B) "Send an official compliance notice to the contractor's manager" 精準同義替換。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A)(C) 皆重複原文 "high-voltage"、"temporary electrical contractors"、"evening shift"，屬於過度推論（並未開除工人）。

questions.q: What are the speakers trying to decide?
options: When to upgrade the existing loading machine
The best financing method for acquiring new automation gear
How much to spend on five-year equipment maintenance
Whether to delay next year's R&D automation projects

explain.text:
• 考點：決策主旨（同義替換）。
• 解析：兩人討論明天要向董事會建議「租賃還是直接購買（whether to lease or purchase）」新自動裝載機，選項 (B) "The best financing method for acquiring new automation gear" 以「取得新自動化設備的最佳融資／付款方式」上位改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(A) 皆重複原文 "R&D automation projects"、"five-year / maintenance"、"loading machine"，但並非兩人正在決策的主題。

questions.q: What does the woman point out about leasing the equipment?
options: It lowers total payments over a five-year period.
It eliminates the $145,000 maintenance expense.
It keeps capital available for future research initiatives.
It provides better tax depreciation than buying outright.

explain.text:
• 考點：優點細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士指出採用三年租賃方案可為明年的研發自動化專案保留現金流（preserve cash flow for next year's R&D automation projects），選項 (C) "It keeps capital available for future research initiatives." 將 preserve cash flow 換為 keeps capital available、R&D projects 換為 research initiatives。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(D) 皆將「買斷」或「男士的擔憂（五年總付款可能較高）」混為一談。

questions.q: What does the man say he will do before tomorrow's board meeting?
options: Calculate a multi-year cost comparison for both options
Negotiate a three-year lease with upgrade terms
Ask the board to approve the $145,000 outright purchase
Review tax depreciation rules with the R&D team

explain.text:
• 考點：說話者接下來行動（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士說下午會算一份五年總擁有成本比較（run a five-year total cost of ownership comparison），選項 (A) "Calculate a multi-year cost comparison for both options" 將 five-year 換為 multi-year、run a comparison 換為 calculate a comparison。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(D) 皆重複原文 "$145,000"、"three-year lease"、"tax depreciation"，但與男士實際要做的分析不符。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
options: To introduce fire officials visiting the South Courtyard
To explain how to operate amber strobe lights
To instruct staff to press emergency stop buttons at 2:00 P.M.
To give advance notice of a scheduled evacuation exercise

explain.text:
• 考點：廣播主旨（同義替換）。
• 解析：廣播宣布今天下午兩點舉行半年一度的消防與緊急疏散測試（semi-annual fire drill and emergency evacuation test），選項 (D) "To give advance notice of a scheduled evacuation exercise" 將 test 換為 exercise、reminder 換為 advance notice。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 皆重複原文 "amber strobe lights"、"emergency stop buttons"、"fire officials"、"South Courtyard"，但皆非廣播主旨。

questions.q: What are machine operators instructed to do at 2:00 P.M.?
options: Remain inside the main control room until cleared
Hit the emergency stop buttons immediately
Put on orange vests before exiting the doorway
Power down running equipment in an orderly sequence

explain.text:
• 考點：指令細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：指示操作員啟動運作中產線的可控停機程序（initiate controlled shutdown sequences on active production lines），選項 (D) "Power down running equipment in an orderly sequence" 將 controlled shutdown 換為 power down in an orderly sequence。
• 誘答分析：(B) 原文明確交代「除非受指示否則不要按緊急停止鈕（do not hit emergency stop buttons）」；(A)(C) 把應變協調員的裝備與位置錯置給一般操作員。

questions.q: Who should remain inside the control room during the exercise?
options: All machine operators on active lines
Local fire officials monitoring the courtyard
Assigned safety leads overseeing utility shutoffs
Staff stationed near the nearest marked doorway

explain.text:
• 考點：留守人員（同義替換）。
• 解析：穿著橘色背心的指定緊急應變協調員（designated emergency coordinators）須留在主控制室監控管線關閉，選項 (C) "Assigned safety leads overseeing utility shutoffs" 將 designated 換為 assigned、coordinators 換為 safety leads。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(D) 皆重複原文 "machine operators"、"fire officials"、"nearest marked doorway"，但這些人皆須疏散至南庭院或來自外部。

questions.q: Who is the intended audience for this message?
options: Procurement coordinators reviewing RFQ numbers
Current suppliers checking online portal registration fees
Couriers delivering paper proposals to the facility
Potential vendors looking to submit business proposals

explain.text:
• 考點：聽眾對象（同義替換）。
• 解析：語音說明投標流程變更，要求所有潛在供應商（prospective suppliers）透過線上平台提交技術企劃與報價，選項 (D) "Potential vendors looking to submit business proposals" 將 prospective suppliers 換為 potential vendors。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(B) 皆抓取原文 "procurement coordinators"、"RFQ numbers"、"couriers"、"Vendor Portal" 製造對象混淆。

questions.q: According to the message, what change took effect this month?
options: Eight-digit RFQ numbers are no longer required.
Hard-copy bid packages are no longer accepted.
The Vendor Portal is closed on the first of each month.
Online pricing sheets must be mailed by courier.

explain.text:
• 考點：本月生效的變更（同義替換）。
• 解析：本月一日起不再受理郵寄或快遞的紙本投標（paper bid submissions sent by mail or courier are no longer accepted），選項 (B) "Hard-copy bid packages are no longer accepted." 將 paper 換為 hard-copy。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(C) 皆重複原文 "eight-digit RFQ"、"pricing sheets / courier"、"first of each month"，但敘述與原文完全相反。

questions.q: How can callers reach a live representative?
options: By remaining on the call after the signal
By calling back after the first of the month
By entering their eight-digit RFQ number on the keypad
By uploading a request on portal.formosaprecision.com

explain.text:
• 考點：轉接方式（同義替換）。
• 解析：語音指示 "stay on the line after the tone to speak with a procurement coordinator"，選項 (A) "By remaining on the call after the signal" 將 stay on the line 換為 remaining on the call、tone 換為 signal。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆重複原文 "eight-digit RFQ"、"portal.formosaprecision.com"、"first of the month"，但均非轉接專員的操作方式。

questions.q: What is the workshop mainly about?
options: Recalibrating gauges that show measurement errors
Deciding when to scrap an entire production lot
Interpreting statistical quality-monitoring charts
Replacing worn cutting inserts on Line 3

explain.text:
• 考點：工作坊主題（同義替換）。
• 解析：主題為在現場應用統計製程管制（SPC）圖表並判斷異常趨勢，選項 (C) "Interpreting statistical quality-monitoring charts" 以上位概念同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A)(B) 皆抓取原文 "worn cutting inserts"、"Line 3"、"measurement errors"、"scrap the entire lot" 作為局部細節陷阱。

questions.q: What does the speaker mean when she says, "A single point outside the control limits doesn't automatically mean we scrap the entire lot"?
options: Staff should investigate potential causes before discarding parts.
Only miscalibrated gauges can cause a point to cross a limit.
New quality technicians should ignore single out-of-control points.
Worn cutting inserts do not affect overall lot quality.

explain.text:
• 考點：句意推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者說明單一數據點超出管制界線不代表就要報廢整批產品，應先確認是否為量測誤差、儀器未校準或可歸屬原因，即 (A)「人員在丟棄零件前應先調查潛在原因（Staff should investigate potential causes before discarding parts.）」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(D) 皆重複原文 "quality technicians"、"miscalibrated gauges"、"worn cutting inserts"，但做出錯誤推論。

questions.q: What will the participants do next?
options: Head out to the shop floor to inspect Line 3
Recalibrate a gauge before plotting a new dataset
Break into groups to replace worn cutting tools
Collaborate in teams to evaluate sample production data

explain.text:
• 考點：接下來活動（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者請大家分成四人小組，每組會拿到 Line 3 的樣本數據來繪圖與找出失控趨勢，選項 (D) "Collaborate in teams to evaluate sample production data" 將 break into small groups 換為 collaborate in teams、sample dataset 換為 sample production data。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(C) 皆重複原文 "shop floor / Line 3"、"gauge"、"cutting tools"，但原文說「在去現場之前」先分組分析數據。

questions.q: Who is most likely speaking?
options: A management-level quality oversight lead
A line leader responsible for the Red Bin
A customer representative handling a recall
A QC engineer inspecting machine tooling

explain.text:
• 考點：講者身分（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者自稱 "senior quality control supervisor"，選項 (A) "A management-level quality oversight lead" 為同義職稱改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(C) 皆挪用表格或獨白出現的 "QC engineer"、"line leader / Red Bin"、"recall" 作為干擾項。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. What must an operator do for the second issue the speaker describes?
options: Stop the machine and tag it
Place it in the Red Bin
Send it to Booth 2 for rework
Hold it for laser re-marking

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽音訊線索＋查表）。
• 解析：音訊中講者依序介紹兩種缺陷：第一種是「超過 2 毫米的表面刮痕」，第二種是「牙距超出容許範圍（thread pitch falls outside acceptable tolerance limits）」，並要求遵循表格對應處置方式。對照表格 Thread Pitch Out of Tolerance 的 Action Required 欄位為 Stop Machine & Tag，故選 (A) Stop the machine and tag it。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(D) 分別為表格中 D-101、D-108、D-112 的處置動作。

questions.q: Why does the speaker emphasize logging the batch number accurately?
options: It helps line leaders sort parts in the Red Bin.
It prevents surface scratches over two millimeters.
It allows quick product tracking during a recall.
It lets the QC engineer inspect tooling faster.

explain.text:
• 考點：強調原因（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者強調準確記錄批號可在發生客訴召回時達成快速追溯（enables rapid traceability if a customer recall ever occurs），選項 (C) "It allows quick product tracking during a recall." 將 rapid traceability 換為 quick product tracking。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(B) 皆重複表格中的 "line leaders / Red Bin"、"QC engineer / tooling"、"surface scratches"，但均非記錄批號的目的。

questions.q: Why is the caller leaving a message?
options: To inform the client of a postponed machinery delivery
To ask Ms. Chen to approve a new tolerance specification
To confirm that a 4-axis machine will ship next Monday
To reschedule a 48-hour factory inspection with Nakamura

explain.text:
• 考點：留言目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：來電通知客製 4 軸切割機因測試未過須更換轉塔模組，導致交期延後五個工作天，選項 (A) "To inform the client of a postponed machinery delivery" 將 delay delivery 換為 postponed delivery、cutting machine 換為 machinery。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(D) 皆重複原文 "4-axis machine / next Monday"、"tolerance"、"48-hour inspection"，但將延後說成準時出貨或扭曲留言目的。

questions.q: What caused the issue mentioned by the caller?
options: The customer requested a custom turret module.
A component did not pass pre-shipment testing.
An operator damaged the turret during programming.
Replacement parts took five business days to arrive.

explain.text:
• 考點：延遲原因（同義替換）。
• 解析：主因是出廠前最終 48 小時試運轉檢驗中，轉塔分度次組件未通過重複性測試（failed our repeatability test），選項 (B) "A component did not pass pre-shipment testing." 將 sub-assembly 換為 component、run-in inspection 換為 pre-shipment testing。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(D) 皆重複原文 "turret module"、"programming"、"five business days" 製造因果錯置。

questions.q: What does the caller offer to provide free of charge?
options: Extra on-site staff instruction after delivery
Free shipping on the replacement turret module
A 48-hour inspection at Ms. Chen's facility
A five-day extension on the repeatability warranty

explain.text:
• 考點：免費補償項目（同義替換）。
• 解析：來電者願免費提供額外兩天現場操作員與程式設計師訓練（two additional days of on-site operator and programmer training completely free of charge），選項 (A) "Extra on-site staff instruction after delivery" 將 additional training 換為 extra staff instruction。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(C) 皆重複原文 "repeatability"、"turret module"、"48-hour inspection" 作為補償內容陷阱。

questions.q: What new requirement is being introduced in the press department?
options: Daily inspections of press guards before each shift
Reporting all near-miss incidents to the maintenance desk
Wearing a coworker's badge when clocking in at Building A
Fingerprint or badge-linked authentication on heavy presses

explain.text:
• 考點：新規定內容（同義替換）。
• 解析：沖壓部門將全面導入綁定員工識別證的生物辨識門禁（biometric badge access on all heavy presses），選項 (D) "Fingerprint or badge-linked authentication on heavy presses" 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(B) 皆挪用原文 "press guards"、"coworker's badge"、"near-miss incidents"、"maintenance desk"，但與實際規定相反（禁止借用同事識別證）。

questions.q: Why did management decide to implement this change?
options: Recent close calls involved unapproved equipment adjustments.
Several operators forgot to clock in last quarter.
The press controller software expired on Monday.
Maintenance requested fewer unauthorized visits to Building A.

explain.text:
• 考點：實施原因（同義替換）。
• 解析：起因是上季發生兩起涉及未經授權調整護罩的虛驚事故（two near-miss incidents last quarter involving unauthorized adjustments），選項 (A) "Recent close calls involved unapproved equipment adjustments." 將 near-miss incidents 換為 close calls、unauthorized 換為 unapproved。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(D) 皆重複原文 "clock in"、"press controller / Monday"、"Building A"，但並非管理階層推動此變革的原因。

questions.q: What should employees do if their badge fails to scan at a machine?
options: Wait until next Monday to re-synchronize the badge
Visit the maintenance desk to reset their access credentials
Energize the press manually from the controller
Borrow a certified coworker's badge temporarily

explain.text:
• 考點：異常應變步驟（同義替換）。
• 解析：若刷卡失敗，應直接向 A 棟維修櫃檯回報以重新同步存取權限（report directly to the maintenance desk ... so they can re-synchronize your access profile），選項 (B) "Visit the maintenance desk to reset their access credentials" 將 re-synchronize access profile 換為 reset access credentials。
• 誘答分析：(D) 原文明確禁止借用同事識別證；(C)(A) 皆抓取原文 "energize the press"、"Monday" 編造錯誤步驟。

questions.q: What is the main subject of the podcast episode?
options: Pre-qualifying automotive transmission lines in Taiwan
Replacing Tier-1 casting parts with alternative materials
Managing the dangers of relying on a single supplier
Negotiating a three-percent volume discount with vendors

explain.text:
• 考點：Podcast 主題（同義替換）。
• 解析：本集探討現代製造業最大弱點之一：單一供應商風險（single-source risk），選項 (C) "Managing the dangers of relying on a single supplier" 將 single-source risk 換為 dangers of relying on a single supplier。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A)(B) 皆抓取原文 "three-percent volume discount"、"transmission"、"casting" 作為局部關鍵字陷阱。

questions.q: What does the speaker advise procurement teams to avoid?
options: Accepting volume discounts from casting foundries
Qualifying a secondary vendor for Tier-1 parts
Depending solely on one vendor for essential components
Halting the main assembly line for annual audits

explain.text:
• 考點：講者建議避免事項（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者建議避免在可能讓主產線停擺的關鍵零件上只依賴單一廠商（Avoid relying on one vendor for any part that could halt your main assembly line），選項 (C) "Depending solely on one vendor for essential components" 將 relying on one vendor 換為 depending solely on one vendor、critical 換為 essential。
• 誘答分析：(B) 預先認證第二供應商是講者「鼓勵」而非「避免」的做法；(A)(D) 皆挪用原文關鍵字但語意扭曲。

questions.q: What example does the speaker give to support his point?
options: A foundry in central Taiwan that closed for three percent savings
An automaker that pre-qualified two backup casting vendors
A transmission plant that suffered a four-week fire
A vehicle-parts maker whose operations stopped after a supplier fire

explain.text:
• 考點：舉例細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者舉例中台灣一家中型汽車零件供應商（automotive supplier）因唯一鑄造廠發生火災而導致變速箱產線停擺四週，選項 (D) "A vehicle-parts maker whose operations stopped after a supplier fire" 將 automotive supplier 換為 vehicle-parts maker、shutting down 換為 operations stopped。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(C) 皆將火災廠房、預先認證備援廠商、四週停線等細節張冠李戴。

questions.q: What trend is the speaker highlighting?
options: Scheduled preventive checks were reduced after Q2.
Total maintenance spending hit $77,000 in the first quarter.
Emergency breakdown expenses climbed along with preventive budgets.
Increased proactive upkeep drove down unexpected repair costs.

explain.text:
• 考點：數據趨勢（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者指出隨著預防保養投資增加，緊急故障停機成本大幅下降，選項 (D) "Increased proactive upkeep drove down unexpected repair costs." 將 preventive maintenance 換為 proactive upkeep、unplanned downtime costs 換為 unexpected repair costs。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(A) 皆與圖表趨勢相反或錯置季別與金額。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. In which quarter did the company first achieve the cost-reduction target mentioned by the speaker?
options: Q1
Q2
Q3
Q4

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽音訊線索＋查表）。
• 解析：音訊中講者提到第一季非計畫停機成本高達 $68,000，而年度目標是「將非計畫停機費用降至第一季數字的一半以下」（即低於 $34,000），並請聽眾從表格找出首次低於該門檻的季度。查表可知 Q2 為 $51,000，直到 (C) Q3 降至 $31,000 才首次達標。
• 誘答分析：(A) 為基準季 $68,000；(B) $51,000 尚未低於 $34,000；(D) $19,000 雖低於門檻但非「首次」達標。

questions.q: What does the speaker recommend for next year's budget?
options: Cutting total maintenance spending below $42,000
Sustaining or modestly increasing funding for monitoring sensors
Eliminating vibration sensors from scheduled Q1 checks
Shifting all preventive maintenance funds to unplanned repairs

explain.text:
• 考點：預算建議（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者強烈建議明年維持或微幅擴大預測性振動感測器預算（maintaining or slightly expanding our predictive vibration-sensor budget），選項 (B) "Sustaining or modestly increasing funding for monitoring sensors" 將 maintaining 換為 sustaining、slightly expanding 換為 modestly increasing。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(C) 皆重複原文 "$42,000"、"unplanned"、"vibration sensors" 與 "Q1"，但方向完全相反。

questions.q: What type of company is being advertised?
options: A manufacturer of optical comparators and pressure gauges
A software provider for tracking NIST certificates
An accredited facility for equipment testing and certification
A consulting firm that conducts on-site quality audits

explain.text:
• 考點：廣告公司類型（同義替換）。
• 解析：廣告主打 AccuLab Metrology 為台灣頂尖工業校準與測試實驗室（industrial calibration and testing laboratory），且具國際品質認證，選項 (C) "An accredited facility for equipment testing and certification" 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(B) 皆重複原文 "optical comparators / pressure gauges"、"quality audits"、"NIST certificates"，但將服務類型誤導為製造商或軟體商。

questions.q: What benefit does the company claim to offer?
options: A two-day completion guarantee on instrument certification
Same-day pickup for all coordinate measuring machines
Free replacement gauges if an audit fails
Unlimited hand-tool repairs before the end of the month

explain.text:
• 考點：服務優勢（同義替換）。
• 解析：承諾儀器認證 48 小時完件（48-hour turnaround on instrument certification），選項 (A) "A two-day completion guarantee on instrument certification" 將 48-hour turnaround 換為 two-day completion guarantee。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(D) 皆挪用原文 "coordinate measuring machines"、"audit"、"hand tools / end of the month" 製造過度推論。

questions.q: How can listeners claim a complimentary sample pickup?
options: By sending their first batch of tools via courier
By phoning the lab prior to month's end
By uploading their certificates to the company portal
By scheduling an audit on the company website

explain.text:
• 考點：優惠領取方式（同義替換）。
• 解析：廣告說明在月底前撥打 04-555-0192 即可享有首次免費到廠收件服務（Call us ... before the end of the month），選項 (B) "By phoning the lab prior to month's end" 將 call 換為 phoning、before the end of the month 換為 prior to month's end。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(A) 皆重複原文 "certificates / company portal"、"audit"、"first batch of hand tools"，但均非領取免費收件的方式。

questions.q: What is the speaker updating the team on?
options: Delaying the December 1 go-live date by two weeks
Restricting user permissions for inventory staff
Replacing legacy purchase orders with paper receipts
Rolling out a new enterprise resource-planning module

explain.text:
• 考點：會議報告主題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者更新團隊即將轉換至新的公司規劃軟體採購與庫存模組（transition to the new company planning software procurement and inventory module），選項 (D) "Rolling out a new enterprise resource-planning module" 為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(B) 皆重複原文 "December 1 / two weeks"、"purchase orders / receipts"、"user permissions"，但皆非報告主題。

questions.q: What does the speaker mean when she says, "We're running parallel systems for the first two weeks of December"?
options: Material receipts will be processed twice on December 14.
Staff will record entries in both the old and new platforms temporarily.
The legacy system will shut down permanently on December 1.
Two departments will test the software on different schedules.

explain.text:
• 考點：句意推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者解釋「雙軌並行兩週」意指員工在 12 月 14 日前須同時在舊系統與新軟體模組登錄交易（log transactions in both the legacy system and the new software module），即 (B)「員工將暫時同時在舊平台與新平台登錄資料（Staff will record entries in both the old and new platforms temporarily.）」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(A) 皆重複原文 "two"、"legacy system / December 1"、"material receipts / December 14"，但曲解雙軌並行的含義。

questions.q: What are department heads asked to do by Friday?
options: Test login credentials before the December 1 launch
Provide the names of staff who need system access
Train their teams on the new inventory module
Finish logging all November purchase orders by 5:00 P.M.

explain.text:
• 考點：待辦事項（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者要求各部門主管在本週五下午五點前提交需要登入權限的員工名單（submit a list of employees who require login credentials），選項 (B) "Provide the names of staff who need system access" 將 submit a list 換為 provide the names、login credentials 換為 system access。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(A) 皆重複原文 "purchase orders / 5:00 P.M."、"inventory module"、"login credentials / December 1"，但並非要求部門主管週五前完成的任務。

questions.q: All machine operators must wear approved eye protection at all times while _______ inside the metal-cutting zone.
options: to work
work
working
worked

explain.text:
• 考點：時間副詞子句的簡化（while + V-ing）。
• 解析：原句為 while they are working inside...，主詞與主要子句相同（All machine operators），省略主詞與 be 動詞後保留現在分詞 working。
• 單字補充：approved (adj.) 核准的；metal-cutting zone 金屬切削區。

questions.q: Because the incoming steel coils failed to meet our material strength _______, the quality assurance team rejected the entire shipment.
options: specific
specifications
specifically
specify

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性與名詞片語搭配。
• 解析：meet our material strength _______ 空格需名詞作 meet 的受詞。specifications（規格）常用複數形表示工程技術規格。
• 單字補充：material strength 材料強度；specification (n.) 規格。

questions.q: The procurement committee will not authorize any capital expenditure exceeding $50,000 _______ three independent vendor quotes have been reviewed.
options: despite
therefore
whereas
until

explain.text:
• 考點：從屬連接詞（時間／條件）。
• 解析：句意為「在審閱三份獨立廠商報價『之前』，採購委員會不會核准超過五萬美元的資本支出」，not ... until 為經典搭配。
• 誘答分析：(A) despite 為介系詞；(C) whereas 表對比；(B) therefore 為副詞，不可連接兩個子句。

questions.q: Regular calibration of assembly wrenches ensures that every fastener on the assembly line is tightened _______ to engineering standards.
options: precision
precise
preciseness
precisely

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞修飾過去分詞（過去分詞具形容詞性質）。
• 解析：is tightened _______ to engineering standards 中，空格修飾動詞 tightened，「精確地鎖緊」，故選副詞 precisely。
• 單字補充：assembly wrench 組裝扳手；fastener (n.) 緊固件。

questions.q: _______ the temporary shortage of electronic relays, our Taoyuan plant managed to fulfill 98 percent of third-quarter orders on schedule.
options: Although
Provided that
Notwithstanding
In addition

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞與連接詞區辨（讓步語氣）。
• 解析：空格後為名詞片語 the temporary shortage of electronic relays，故需介系詞；Notwithstanding（儘管、雖然）等於 Despite / In spite of。
• 誘答分析：(A) Although 與 (B) Provided that 後須接完整子句；(D) In addition 語意不合且須加 to 才能接名詞。

questions.q: Before _______ the heavy press for routine die maintenance, technicians are required to apply a personal padlock to the main breaker.
options: isolation
isolated
isolating
isolate

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞後接動名詞（Before + V-ing）。
• 解析：Before 在此作介系詞使用，後面已有受詞 the heavy press，故須填入動名詞 isolating（隔離、斷電隔離），不可選名詞 isolation。
• 單字補充：heavy press 液壓沖床；padlock (n.) 掛鎖。

questions.q: Had the night-shift supervisor noticed the coolant leak earlier, the main bearing _______ severe thermal damage.
options: will avoid
would avoid
would have avoided
had avoided

explain.text:
• 考點：與過去事實相反的假設語氣倒裝句。
• 解析：Had the night-shift supervisor noticed... 等於 If the night-shift supervisor had noticed...，為與過去事實相反，主要子句動詞須用 would have + p.p.，故選 would have avoided。
• 單字補充：main bearing 主軸軸承；thermal damage 熱損傷。

questions.q: The new automated optical inspection system is capable of _______ tiny surface cracks at full conveyor speed.
options: detected
detects
detect
detecting

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞片語搭配（be capable of + V-ing）。
• 解析：of 為介系詞，後接動名詞 detecting。
• 單字補充：surface crack 表面裂紋。

questions.q: Suppliers wishing to bid on the production room air-conditioning upgrade must submit their technical proposals _______ 5:00 P.M. on Friday, November 27.
options: in order that
no later than
rather than
as soon as

explain.text:
• 考點：時間截止介系詞片語。
• 解析：表示「不遲於（某時間點）」，標準商用與採購用語為 no later than。
• 誘答分析：(D) as soon as 後接子句；(A) in order that 表目的且接子句；(C) rather than 表「而非」。

questions.q: Under the revised workplace safety standard, plant managers are held directly _______ for documenting workplace hazard assessments.
options: accountably
accountable
accountability
account

explain.text:
• 考點：固定搭配（hold someone accountable for...）。
• 解析：主動為 hold plant managers accountable for...，改為被動即 plant managers are held directly accountable for...（被追究直接責任）。
• 單字補充：hazard assessment 危害評估。

questions.q: The vibration sensor installed on Turbine 3 triggered an alert, _______ an immediate inspection by the reliability engineering team.
options: prompting
prompted
prompt
to prompt

explain.text:
• 考點：分詞構句表結果。
• 解析：逗號前為完整子句，逗號後無連接詞，須用現在分詞 prompting（進而促使……）表示前面動作所帶來的直接結果。
• 單字補充：reliability engineering 可靠度工程。

questions.q: _______ of the two laser-cutting machines offered by Kintex Robotics meets our throughput target without requiring a power supply upgrade.
options: Many
Both
Few
Neither

explain.text:
• 考點：不定代名詞主謂一致。
• 解析：空格後有 of the two...，且動詞為單數 meets，故須選單數代名詞 Neither（兩者皆不）。(B) Both、(C) Few、(A) Many 皆須搭配複數動詞 meet。
• 單字補充：throughput (n.) 產出量、吞吐量；power supply 電源供應器。

questions.q: To prevent cross-contamination between batches, the mixing vats must be thoroughly sanitized _______ each production run.
options: following
throughout
beside
among

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞語意（following = after）。
• 解析：句意為「在每次生產作業『之後』必須徹底消毒混合槽」，following 作介系詞表示「在……之後」。
• 單字補充：cross-contamination (n.) 交叉污染；sanitize (v.) 消毒。

questions.q: Only after the third-party safety auditor signed the compliance certificate _______ allowed to resume operations on Line 2.
options: the staff was
the staff were
was the staff
were the staff

explain.text:
• 考點：Only + 副詞子句置於句首的倒裝句。
• 解析：Only after + 子句 置於句首時，主要子句須倒裝（助動詞／be 動詞移到主詞前）。在美式商業英語中，集合名詞 staff 常視為單數整體，搭配 was the staff（註：英式英語偶用 were，多益測驗以美式標準單數 was 為正解）。

questions.q: While Vendor A's unit price is slightly higher, its extended warranty and local spare-parts inventory make it the more _______ choice over five years.
options: economical
economic
economically
economy

explain.text:
• 考點：形似字辨析（economical vs. economic）。
• 解析：economical 意為「省錢的、划算的、符合經濟效益的」；economic 意為「經濟學的、國家經濟的」。此處指五年下來較划算的選擇，故選 economical。

questions.q: Every hazardous chemical container stored in Warehouse D must bear a clearly legible label _______ its flash point and first-aid measures.
options: indicated
indicate
indicating
indication

explain.text:
• 考點：現在分詞片語作後位修飾。
• 解析：a clearly legible label _______ its flash point...，標籤主動「標示、顯示」閃燃點與急救措施，故用現在分詞 indicating。
• 單字補充：flash point 閃燃點。

questions.q: The purchasing director requested a detailed breakdown of freight surcharges, _______ she suspected the carrier had double-billed for customs brokerage.
options: so
yet
nor
for

explain.text:
• 考點：對等連接詞 for 表原因。
• 解析：前後為兩個獨立子句，後半句說明「因為她懷疑承運商重複收取報關費」，for 可置於句中逗號後表補充說明原因（相當於 because）。
• 單字補充：customs brokerage 報關費；surcharge (n.) 附加費。

questions.q: _______ the prototype housing undergoes drop-testing next week, the tooling department will finalize the aluminum production mold.
options: Unless
During
Once
Except

explain.text:
• 考點：時間從屬連接詞。
• 解析：空格後為完整子句 the prototype housing undergoes...，表示「一旦原型外殼下週完成落摔測試，模具部門就會定案鋁模模穴」，Once（一旦）最符合語意與文法。
• 誘答分析：(B) During 與 (D) Except 為介系詞；(A) Unless 語意相反。

questions.q: Please ensure that all air hoses are coiled neatly off the walkway so that they do not _______ a tripping hazard for forklift spotters.
options: pose
raise
lean
place

explain.text:
• 考點：動賓固定搭配（pose a hazard）。
• 解析：「構成／造成危害」的固定搭配為 pose a hazard / risk / threat。
• 單字補充：air hose 氣壓軟管；tripping hazard 絆倒危害。

questions.q: Mr. Lin's _______ negotiation of the annual raw-material contract saved the manufacturing division nearly $140,000 in material costs.
options: obsolete
reluctant
fragile
adept

explain.text:
• 考點：高階形容詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：adept 意為「熟練的、內行的、高明的」，形容林先生高明的談判為製造部門省下近 14 萬美元。
• 誘答分析：(C) fragile 脆弱的；(B) reluctant 不情願的；(A) obsolete 過時的。

questions.q: Any non-conforming parts identified during final outgoing inspection must be _______ in the holding area until a disposition is issued.
options: segregating
segregated
segregate
segregation

explain.text:
• 考點：被動語態與品管字彙。
• 解析：不合格零件「必須被隔離」在隔離籠中，主詞為物且搭配 must be，故選過去分詞 segregated。
• 單字補充：disposition (n.) 處置決議（品管術語）；holding area 隔離區／隔離籠。

questions.q: The updated equipment-lock policy applies equally to full-time plant personnel and _______ contractors performing electrical work on site.
options: external
redundant
marginal
interior

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：與前面的 full-time plant personnel（廠內正職員工）對比，在現場進行電氣作業的是「外部」承包商，故選 external。
• 誘答分析：(D) interior 內部的；(C) marginal 邊緣的；(B) redundant 多餘的。

questions.q: By the time the replacement electric motor arrives from Osaka tomorrow afternoon, the maintenance crew _______ the mounting bracket.
options: will have prepared
has prepared
is preparing
will prepare

explain.text:
• 考點：未來完成式（By the time + 現在式，主要子句用 will have + p.p.）。
• 解析：By the time 引導未來時間點（明天下午馬達送達時），維修組「屆時已經準備好」安裝支架，強調動作在未來某時間點前完成，用 will have prepared。
• 單字補充：mounting bracket 安裝支架。

questions.q: _______ fluctuations in global copper prices, the procurement office locked in a fixed-rate six-month supply agreement.
options: Anticipated
Anticipating
To anticipate
Having been anticipated

explain.text:
• 考點：分詞構句（主動語態）。
• 解析：主要子句主詞 the procurement office 主動「預期、預見到」全球銅價波動，故用現在分詞 Anticipating。
• 單字補充：lock in 鎖定（價格／利率）；fluctuation (n.) 波動。

questions.q: The plant safety committee recommended _______ emergency eyewash stations within ten seconds' walking distance of all chemical-cleaning tanks.
options: installed
installer
installing
to install

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞搭配（recommend + V-ing）。
• 解析：recommend 若直接接動作時須用動名詞 installing（不可接不定詞 to install）。
• 誘答分析：(D) recommend 不可直接接不定詞；(A) 過去分詞不合；(B) installer（安裝人員）詞性與語意皆不合。

questions.q: Although the newly acquired testing device is highly accurate, its delicate optical lenses are _______ to sudden temperature shifts.
options: immune
compatible
resistant
susceptible

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞搭配介系詞 to 的字彙辨析。
• 解析：雖然新光譜儀很精準，但精密光學鏡片「容易受……影響」而損壞或失準，be susceptible to（易受……影響／敏感）最符合 Although 的轉折語氣。
• 誘答分析：(B) compatible with（注意介系詞為 with）；(C) resistant（抗……）與 (A) immune（免疫於……）皆與 Although 語氣矛盾。

questions.q: Invoices that lack a valid purchase order reference number will be returned to the vendor _______ delay, as our accounting system cannot process them.
options: upon
without
with
in

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞片語（without delay = immediately）。
• 解析：without delay 為固定片語，意為「毫不延遲地、立即地」，指缺少有效採購單號的發票會立即退回給廠商。

questions.q: _______ defective components are detected early in the sub-assembly stage, rework expenses remain relatively minimal.
options: As long as
In case of
Regardless of
Even though

explain.text:
• 考點：條件從屬連接詞。
• 解析：空格後為完整子句，As long as（只要）表示條件：「只要在次組裝階段及早偵測出不良元件，重工費用就相對極低」。
• 誘答分析：(B)、(C) 為介系詞片語，不可接完整子句；(D) 語意相反。

questions.q: The engineering team conducted a _______ root-cause analysis to determine why the rubber seals degraded prematurely.
options: casual
rigorous
tentative
vague

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：rigorous（嚴謹的、徹底的）搭配 root-cause analysis（根本原因分析），符合品管工程語境。
• 誘答分析：(A) casual 隨便的；(D) vague 模糊的；(C) tentative 暫定的。

questions.q: Ms. Wu was promoted to Senior Procurement Specialist in recognition of her _______ track record in qualifying reliable Tier-1 suppliers.
options: proof
proven
prove
proving

explain.text:
• 考點：過去分詞作形容詞（proven track record）。
• 解析：proven track record 為商業英語高頻搭配，意為「經證實的良好實績」。
• 單字補充：Tier-1 supplier 一階供應商。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (131).
options: Similarly
Consequently
Otherwise
Nevertheless

explain.text:
• 考點：轉折副詞（因果關係）。
• 解析：前句說明過去兩個月表面處理不良率上升到無法接受的程度，本句提出對策「決定改採更嚴格的 Level 0.65 標準」，兩者為因果關係，故選 Consequently（因此）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (132).
options: in spite of
by means of
with regard to
on behalf of

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞片語（方法、工具）。
• 解析：透過校準過的數位高度規來驗證尺寸公差，by means of（藉由、透過）最精準。
• 誘答分析：(A) 儘管；(D) 代表；(C) 關於。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (133).
options: Several vendors have already agreed to absorb the extra freight costs.
The warehouse expansion project is expected to conclude ahead of schedule.
Furthermore, surface gloss readings must be recorded at three distinct points on each sampled bar.
Annual safety refresher courses will be held in the main auditorium next Tuesday.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題（語意連貫）。
• 解析：前句講收貨檢驗員須用高度規驗證尺寸公差，後句講不良品隔離規定；(C)「此外，每根抽樣鋁條須在三個不同點位記錄表面光澤度讀數」完美延續「進料檢驗步驟」。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (134).
options: length
lengthy
lengthens
lengthen

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞詞性與型態。
• 解析：情態助動詞 may 後須接原形動詞 lengthen（延長），指此變更在過渡期可能會拉長收貨周轉時間。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (135).
options: Therefore
Moreover
For instance
However

explain.text:
• 考點：轉折副詞（對比轉折）。
• 解析：前句說工程團隊對能效等級大致滿意，本句說「在發出正式採購單前，需要釐清兩項商務條款」，語氣轉折，選 However。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (136).
options: replicate
suspend
expedite
postpone

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：因為現有空壓機快壽終正寢，詢問貴廠能否「加快／趕工（expedite）」生產，讓至少四台在五週內交貨。
• 誘答分析：(B) 暫停；(D) 延後；(A) 複製。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (137).
options: Our Changhua facility recently earned environmental quality certification.
Unfortunately, the previous vendor failed to honor its two-year warranty.
We would like to know whether those services can be bundled into a single all-inclusive price.
Please ensure that all shipping crates are labeled with our internal asset numbers.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：前句提到「報價單寫明試車與現場操作員訓練另計」，(C)「我們想了解這些服務是否能打包成單一全包價（all-inclusive price）」緊扣前句的費用議題。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (138).
options: addressing
addressed
address
addresses

explain.text:
• 考點：現在分詞作後位修飾。
• 解析：an updated proposal _______ these points，企劃書／報價單主動「處理、回應（address）」這些問題，故用現在分詞 addressing。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (139).
options: although
because
unless
whether

explain.text:
• 考點：名詞／副詞子句搭配（whether ... or not）。
• 解析：句尾有 or not，構成 whether ... or not（無論是否），指無論是否懷疑有行人存在，堆高機在盲區路口都必須完全停下並鳴笛。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (140).
options: Inventory cycle counts will be paused during the upcoming holiday weekend.
Crossing outside designated lanes without eye contact with the operator is strictly prohibited.
Electric forklifts must be plugged into charging stations at the end of every shift.
Earplugs are available in dispensers mounted near the heavy presses.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：前後文皆聚焦於「倉庫走道內的行人安全規範與綠色行人通道」，(B)「嚴禁在未與駕駛員進行眼神確認的情況下於指定車道外穿越」完全符合段落主題。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (141).
options: The warehouse roof repairs were completed by an external roofing contractor last month.
All temporary seasonal workers must attend an orientation session on Monday morning.
Forklift batteries typically last for eight hours of continuous operation before requiring water.
This upgrade will project a bright spot fifteen feet ahead of moving vehicles to alert nearby workers.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題（指代銜接）。
• 解析：前句提到「所有 14 台電動堆高機正加裝藍色 LED 地面投影警示燈」，(D) 句首 This upgrade 直接指代該升級，並說明其功能（在車輛前方 15 英尺投影亮點以警示附近人員）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (142).
options: violations
violate
violating
violators

explain.text:
• 考點：名詞複數型態與字彙辨析。
• 解析：repeated _______ 後接動詞 will result in，表示「一再發生的違規行為」會導致正式懲處，應選指「違規事件」的複數名詞 violations（而非指人的 violators）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (143).
options: Accordingly
In contrast
Regardless
Meanwhile

explain.text:
• 考點：轉折副詞（因果結論）。
• 解析：前段說明該批次六角螺栓在高扭力下可能有剪力強度不足的風險，本段結論「因此，強烈建議所有客戶立即停用該批次剩餘庫存」，選 Accordingly（因此、據此）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (144).
options: Our sales team will be exhibiting at the Taipei Hardware Show next month.
Payment terms for fourth-quarter invoices will remain net 45 days.
If any bolts from this batch have already been installed in critical assemblies, please notify our engineering team for a safety-verification check.
Grade 8.8 bolts are generally used for lighter non-structural applications.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：前句講「立即停用剩餘庫存」，(C)「若該批次已有任何螺栓安裝於關鍵組件中，請通知我方工程團隊進行扭力驗證程序」補充了「已安裝部分」的處置方式，邏輯最嚴密。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (145).
options: affected
affecting
affects
affect

explain.text:
• 考點：過去分詞作前置形容詞。
• 解析：the _______ units 指「受影響的」螺栓，過去分詞 affected 修飾 units 表被動狀態。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (146).
options: disrupt
disruption
disrupted
disruptive

explain.text:
• 考點：名詞詞性。
• 解析：any _______ 須接名詞作 apologize for 的受詞，故選 disruption（中斷、干擾）。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the notice?
options: To instruct supervisors in Building B to lock out air-driven tools
To announce that Precision Machining will relocate to Building B
To alert personnel to a scheduled utility interruption in two facilities
To report an emergency leak in the high-pressure receiver tanks

explain.text:
• 考點：公告主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：公告通知 11 月 21 日將進行維護，A 棟與 C 棟的壓縮空氣管線將洩壓停用（depressurized），選項 (C) "To alert personnel to a scheduled utility interruption in two facilities" 將 scheduled maintenance 與 air lines depressurized 改寫為 scheduled utility interruption，並以 two facilities 對應 Buildings A and C。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(B) 皆重複原文 "Building B"、"air-driven tools"、"high-pressure receiver tanks"，但錯置對象或誤將計畫性維修說成突發故障。

questions.q: Which area will NOT lose air power on November 21?
options: Building A
Building B
Building C
All buildings will be affected.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節排除題（NOT）。
• 解析：最後一句明確指出 Building B (Production Assembly) relies on an independent nitrogen-backup compressor and will remain fully operational.，故 B 棟不受影響，選 (B)。

questions.q: What is indicated about the calibration certificates?
options: They will be mailed separately thirty days after delivery.
Every document corresponds to an individual tool's unique identifier.
They must be placed inside Carton #1 by the receiving team.
They are billed at $240.00 per unit under SKU DTS-500.

explain.text:
• 考點：附註細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：訂單備註說明 Calibration certificates are serialized to each tool...，選項 (B) "Every document corresponds to an individual tool's unique identifier." 將 serialized to each tool 改寫為 corresponds to an individual tool's unique identifier。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A)(C) 皆挪用原文 "$240.00"、"DTS-500"、"Net 30 Days"、"Carton #1"，但扭曲價格、寄送時間或責任歸屬。

questions.q: Under the listed shipping terms, who is responsible for paying import duties?
options: Both companies equally
Kronos Industrial Supply
The Changhua Industrial Park administration
Formosa Precision Optics

explain.text:
• 考點：交貨條件（Shipping Terms）細節題。
• 解析：訂單標示 Shipping Terms: DDP (Delivered Duty Paid)，意為「稅訖交貨條件」，由賣方（Kronos Industrial Supply）負擔運費與進口關稅，選 (B)。

questions.q: What problem is reported on Line 3?
options: The staging cabinet ran out of 12V power-module bonding paste.
The cold-storage unit failed to keep Lot #SP-774 at room temperature.
Defect rates on the power-module boards have surpassed client limits.
Forty-five boards were damaged during X-ray inspection at 8:00 A.M.

explain.text:
• 考點：即時通訊對話細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：Jason Wu 回報 X 光檢測顯示氣孔率平均達 28%，超過 20% 客戶上限（exceeds our 20% customer limit），選項 (C) "Defect rates on the power-module boards have surpassed client limits." 將 voids averaging 28% 換為 defect rates、exceeds customer limit 換為 surpassed client limits。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D)(A) 皆重複原文 "cold storage"、"room temperature"、"45 boards"、"staging cabinet"，但捏造冷藏庫故障或機台問題。

questions.q: What does Jason Wu mean when he writes, "You nailed it"?
options: The line lead followed the four-hour stabilization procedure.
Marcus correctly identified the root cause of the issue.
Marcus successfully repaired the X-ray inspection unit.
The 45 quarantined boards can be released before 11:00 A.M.

explain.text:
• 考點：口語慣用語推論題（同義替換）。
• 解析：Marcus 推測只回溫 30 分鐘導致結露排氣，Jason 向產線組長確認後回覆 "You nailed it."，即 (B)「Marcus 正確找出了問題的根本原因（Marcus correctly identified the root cause of the issue.）」。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(C) 皆重複原文 "four-hour stabilization"、"45 quarantined boards"、"11:00 A.M."，但與事實相反。

questions.q: What will Marcus Chen most likely do next?
options: Leave Lot #SP-774 out until 11:00 A.M. for stabilization
Quarantine the 45 boards produced on Line 3
Ask the line lead to re-inspect the cold-stored jar
Fetch a properly acclimated adhesive container from storage

explain.text:
• 考點：接下來行動預測（同義替換）。
• 解析：Elena 指示 Marcus "pull a properly acclimated jar from the staging cabinet"，選項 (D) "Fetch a properly acclimated adhesive container from storage" 將 pull 換為 fetch、jar 換為 container、bonding paste 換為 adhesive。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(C) 皆抓取原文 "45 boards"、"Lot #SP-774 / 11:00 A.M."、"cold-stored jar"，進行錯置與誤導。

questions.q: According to the SOP, which item must be put on FIRST during the gowning sequence?
options: Knee-high boot covers
A sterile hood
Inner nitrile gloves
A head covering

explain.text:
• 考點：SOP 步驟順序（上位概念／同義替換）。
• 解析：第 2 條著裝順序（Top-Down）寫明先戴 hairnet（髮網），選項 (D) "A head covering" 以上位概念同義替換 hairnet。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(B) 皆為流程中較後面的穿戴項目。

questions.q: What are personnel required to do immediately after crossing the step-over bench?
options: Disinfect their gloved hands with an alcohol solution
Pass their calibration weights through the air-shower box
Wipe the step-over bench with lint-free wipes
Put on inner nitrile gloves before entering the vestibule

explain.text:
• 考點：SOP 動作細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：第 3 條規定跨過跨坐凳後須在手套上塗抹 70% 異丙醇（apply 70% isopropyl alcohol to your gloves），選項 (A) "Disinfect their gloved hands with an alcohol solution" 為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(C) 皆重複原文 "inner nitrile gloves"、"calibration weights / air-shower box"、"lint-free wipes"，但將前後步驟順序錯置。

questions.q: What is NOT permitted inside the production room?
options: Conventional cellulose-based stationery
Outer production gloves sanitized with alcohol
Approved synthetic paper notebooks
Calibration weights that passed through the air-shower box

explain.text:
• 考點：禁止事項（NOT 細節題，同義替換）。
• 解析：第 4 條明文禁止一般木漿紙（Standard wood-pulp paper is forbidden），選項 (A) "Conventional cellulose-based stationery" 以同義詞改寫 standard wood-pulp paper。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 皆為 SOP 允許或規定使用的物品。

questions.q: What did Vanguard Motion Co. do before adopting wireless vibration sensors?
options: It generated work orders automatically from the parts crib.
It monitored acoustic and temperature data across 36 press lines.
It serviced equipment at predetermined time intervals.
It only replaced bearings after unplanned press downtime occurred.

explain.text:
• 考點：今昔對比細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：文章指出過去該公司依賴固定行事曆排程保養（relied on fixed calendar-based maintenance intervals），選項 (C) "It serviced equipment at predetermined time intervals." 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D)(A) 皆重複原文 "acoustic and temperature data / 36 press lines"、"bearings / unplanned press downtime"、"parts crib"，將現行作法誤當作過去作法。

questions.q: What happens automatically when a bearing's vibration level exceeds a 12 percent deviation?
options: Technicians replace the bearing during the next scheduled check.
Howard Tseng receives an alert to shut down the press line.
The predictive analytics platform resets the baseline threshold.
A repair ticket is logged and replacement components are set aside.

explain.text:
• 考點：系統自動觸發機制（同義替換）。
• 解析：當軸承振動偏差超過 12%，系統會自動在保養佇列產生工單並在零件室預留替換套件（automatically generates a work order ... and reserves the required replacement kit），選項 (D) "A repair ticket is logged and replacement components are set aside." 精準同義替換。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(C) 皆重複原文 "Howard Tseng"、"scheduled check"、"baseline threshold"，屬於過度推論或錯誤動作。

questions.q: What is stated about the financial return of the sensor project?
options: An additional $180,000 was spent on replacement kits.
The platform took twelve months to reduce scrap by 44 percent.
Overtime expenses rose slightly during the first nine months.
The $180,000 outlay was recouped in less than a year.

explain.text:
• 考點：財務回報細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：廠長指出 $180,000 的投資在九個月內即回本（paid for itself in under nine months），選項 (D) "The $180,000 outlay was recouped in less than a year." 將 paid for itself 換為 was recouped、under nine months 換為 in less than a year。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(A) 皆挪用原文 "overtime"、"twelve months / 44 percent"、"replacement kits"，但與數據事實相反。

questions.q: Why did Grace Yang send this e-mail?
options: To ask Mr. Chang to reschedule the December 3 facility visit
To bill the Hsinchu facility $120 for calibration van access
To notify Apex Connectors that two engineers are unavailable
To finalize arrangements for scheduled on-site instrument testing

explain.text:
• 考點：電子郵件主旨（同義替換）。
• 解析：信件主旨與首段旨在確認 12 月 3 日到廠進行年度校準的細節，選項 (D) "To finalize arrangements for scheduled on-site instrument testing" 將 confirm details 換為 finalize arrangements、calibration 換為 instrument testing。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(B) 皆重複原文 "December 3"、"two engineers"、"$120 / calibration van"，但扭曲發信目的。

questions.q: What preparation is requested before December 3?
options: Maintaining consistent climate conditions in the testing area
Paying the $120 hourly mechanical adjustment fee by November 25
Sending the 14 micrometers and 6 height gauges to Hsinchu
Tagging out-of-tolerance Precision Measuring Machines in advance

explain.text:
• 考點：事前準備要求（同義替換）。
• 解析：信中要求至少提前 12 小時將量測室溫度穩定在 20°C（metrology room temperature is stabilized at 20°C），選項 (A) "Maintaining consistent climate conditions in the testing area" 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(D) 皆挪用原文 "14 micrometers / 6 height gauges"、"$120 hourly / November 25"、"Precision Measuring Machines"，但均非所要求的事前準備。

questions.q: What will happen if an instrument fails to meet tolerance standards?
options: The two accredited engineers will adjust it free of charge.
A follow-up calibration van will return on November 25.
It will receive a restricted-status tag unless on-site repair is authorized.
Its accuracy verification will be invalidated for 12 hours.

explain.text:
• 考點：異常處理條件（同義替換）。
• 解析：若儀器超出公差，除非授權現場機械調整，否則將被貼上「LIMITED USE」標籤（tagged "LIMITED USE" unless you authorize on-site mechanical adjustment），選項 (C) "It will receive a restricted-status tag unless on-site repair is authorized." 精準對應。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A)(B) 皆重複原文 "accuracy verification / 12 hours"、"two accredited engineers"、"November 25"，但與規定相反。

questions.q: Based on the procurement policy note, which vendor is ineligible for 24/7 lines?
options: PackPro Robotics
TitanWrap Systems
EcoStretch Solutions
All three vendors are eligible.

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表＋政策備註交叉比對。
• 解析：政策備註規定當地服務回應時間超過 12 小時即自動淘汰，TitanWrap Systems 為 < 24 hours，故不符資格，選 (B)。

questions.q: Which vendor offers the highest film pre-stretch ratio?
options: PackPro Robotics
TitanWrap Systems
EcoStretch Solutions
PackPro Robotics and EcoStretch Solutions tie.

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表數據比較。
• 解析：Film Pre-Stretch Ratio 欄位中，PackPro Robotics 為 300% 最高，選 (A)。

questions.q: What is the single most heavily weighted criterion in the RFP?
options: Local Service Response
Throughput
Warranty Period
Equipment Price

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表權重比較。
• 解析：Equipment Price 權重達 30% 為最高，選 (D)。

questions.q: What prompted the Safety Compliance Office to issue this memorandum?
options: Violations observed during an unannounced compliance check
A new requirement to build a six-meter fire-rated partition wall
A forklift accident involving 200-liter drums of corrosive acids
A chemical spill near the spill-response kits at Doors 2 and 5

explain.text:
• 考點：備忘錄發文原因（同義替換）。
• 解析：首句說明是因昨天突襲消防安全巡檢的發現（During yesterday's unannounced fire-safety walkthrough, inspectors noted...），選項 (A) "Violations observed during an unannounced compliance check" 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 皆重複原文 "Doors 2 and 5"、"200-liter drums / corrosive acids"、"six-meter fire-rated partition wall"，但並非發文起因。

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
     "This practice poses a severe environmental and fire hazard if a forklift tine punctures a drum."

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題（語意連貫）。
• 解析：插入句中的 "This practice" 指涉前一句「把 200 公升丙酮桶直接放在木棧板上且無防溢圍堰」，故接在 [1] 最為順暢，選 (A)。

questions.q: Who is permitted to clean up a leaking chemical drum?
options: The shift supervisor alerted during the evacuation
Staff who have obtained advanced safety clearance
The first warehouse worker who observes the leak
Any employee trained to restock absorbent pads at Door 2

explain.text:
• 考點：權責對象細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：末句規定必須具備 Safety Level 2 認證人員才可進行清理（unless certified under Safety Level 2），選項 (B) "Staff who have obtained advanced safety clearance" 為上位改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(D) 皆重複原文 "warehouse worker"、"shift supervisor / evacuation"、"absorbent pads at Door 2"，但均無清理權限。

questions.q: What was the primary cause of the vacuum pump's failure?
options: Carbonized residue inside a defective OEM rotor vane
Severe scoring that occurred after 10,000 operating hours
Failure by TechServe to perform the 500-hour oil analysis
Moisture intrusion and unapproved oil viscosity

explain.text:
• 考點：故障主因（同義替換）。
• 解析：Root-Cause Findings 指出油品檢測發現 4.2% 水分污染與非原廠錯誤黏度合成油（water contamination and non-OEM synthetic oil viscosity），選項 (D) "Moisture intrusion and unapproved oil viscosity" 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(C) 皆重複原文 "severe scoring / 10,000 operating hours"、"carbonized residue / rotor vane"、"500-hour"，但因果錯置。

questions.q: What is the status of the warranty claim?
options: Approved for the $3,850 repair minus lubricant costs
Covered only if the customer switches to Grade 100 oil
Pending further disassembly of the exhaust chamber
Rejected because required upkeep rules were not followed

explain.text:
• 考點：保固狀態與原因（同義替換）。
• 解析：保固判定為 DENIED，因為使用未授權潤滑油且未依 500 小時保養排程排水，選項 (D) "Rejected because required upkeep rules were not followed" 將 denied 換為 rejected、maintenance schedule 換為 upkeep rules。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(B) 皆挪用原文 "$3,850"、"exhaust chamber"、"Grade 100 oil"，但與 DENIED 狀態相悖。

questions.q: How much will the repair cost the customer?
options: Nothing; it is covered under warranty.

explain.text:
• 考點：費用數字題。
• 解析：末句明載 repair costs ($3,850) must be borne by the customer，選 (C)。

questions.q: What must a supplier do within two business days of receiving a corrective action request?
options: Take prompt action to isolate and inspect suspect inventory
Implement error-proofing fixtures and automated sensors
Appeal to the Supplier Review Board to avoid New Business Hold
Submit a formal root-cause report across all similar product lines

explain.text:
• 考點：時間與行動對應（同義替換）。
• 解析：第一段規定收到矯正請求後兩個工作天內須確認並執行即時圍堵行動（implement immediate containment actions—such as 100% sorting of inventory），選項 (A) "Take prompt action to isolate and inspect suspect inventory" 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 皆挪用原文 "root-cause report"、"Supplier Review Board / New Business Hold"、"error-proofing fixtures"，但屬於其他階段要求。

questions.q: According to the manual, why would a root-cause report be automatically rejected?
options: If it attributes defects to staff mistakes without structural safeguards
If it is not acknowledged within 24 business hours of issuance
If it is submitted after the ten-business-day deadline
If it omits 100% sorting of inventory at the supplier's warehouse

explain.text:
• 考點：自動退件原因（同義替換）。
• 解析：第二段末句指出若只歸咎「操作員失誤」而缺乏系統性製程防呆措施，報告將自動退件（Simply citing "operator error" ... without systemic process controls ... will result in automatic rejection），選項 (A) "If it attributes defects to staff mistakes without structural safeguards" 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D)(C) 皆重複原文 "24 business hours"、"100% sorting"、"ten-business-day"，但皆非自動退件的條件。

questions.q: What is the benefit of achieving "Certified Dock-to-Stock" status?
options: Automatic removal from New Business Hold status
Waiver of formal corrective action requests for four consecutive quarters
Freedom from standard arrival quality checks
Exemption from submitting root-cause reports within ten days

explain.text:
• 考點：認證資格好處（同義替換）。
• 解析：末句說明該計畫可豁免例行進料檢驗（exempting their shipments from routine receiving inspection），選項 (C) "Freedom from standard arrival quality checks" 將 exempting from routine receiving inspection 換為 freedom from standard arrival quality checks。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(D) 皆重複原文 "four consecutive quarters"、"New Business Hold"、"ten days"，但屬錯誤推論。

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
     "Our QA engineers will then verify the effectiveness of these systemic changes over the next three consecutive production lots."

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題（指代詞銜接）。
• 解析：插入句中的 "these systemic changes" 承接 [2] 前一句的 "systemic process controls (e.g., error-proofing fixtures or automated sensors)"，故置於 [2] 最恰當，選 (B)。

questions.q: What is the maximum machine width Kevin Hsu can accommodate?
options: 3.2 meters
3.5 meters
5.0 meters
6.0 meters

explain.text:
