• 解析：Document 1 要求機台寬度不可超過 3.5 公尺（footprint not exceeding 3.5 meters in width），選 (B)。

questions.q: Why does Kuroda recommend the $18,500 option?
options: It raises the base machine's spindle speed to 18,000 RPM.
It supports cutting the specific aerospace metal Delta Alloys uses.
It waives the 30% deposit requirement until December 11.
It shortens the six-week ocean transit to Taichung Port.

explain.text:
• 考點：推薦項目原因（同義替換）。
• 解析：報價單表格中 $18,500 的高壓冷卻系統備註為 Recommended for titanium，而客戶在 Document 1 明確提到要加工航太鈦合金（handling titanium alloys），選項 (B) "It supports cutting the specific aerospace metal Delta Alloys uses." 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(C) 皆重複原文 "18,000 RPM"、"six-week ocean transit"、"30% deposit / December 11"，但皆非推薦該選配的原因。

questions.q: What is included in the base package without an extra line-item fee?
options: Setup, alignment, and multi-day staff instruction
High-pressure coolant system for titanium
CIF Taichung Port ocean freight and insurance
An 8-week expedited factory build schedule

explain.text:
• 考點：含於報價內項目（同義替換）。
• 解析：報價單第四列 On-Site Installation, Leveling & 3-Day Operator Training 價格欄標示 Included，選項 (A) "Setup, alignment, and multi-day staff instruction" 將 installation 換為 setup、leveling 換為 alignment、3-day training 換為 multi-day staff instruction。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(D) 在表格中皆另有獨立計費或屬於時程條件。

questions.q: According to the quotation, what is the total time required from deposit receipt to port arrival?
options: 6 weeks
8 weeks
10 weeks
14 weeks

explain.text:
• 考點：交期加總計算（跨段落）。
• 解析：收到 30% 訂金後，工廠製造前置時間為 8 週（8 weeks）加上遠洋海運 6 週（6 weeks），合計 14 週，選 (D)。

questions.q: What must Delta Alloys do to ensure the machine is commissioned before its early March audit?
options: Request a 60-tool automatic tool changer instead of 60 tools
Extend the quotation validity period beyond December 11
Arrange a local Kuroda Taiwan engineer before November 11
Finalize the order and initial payment by the specified cutoff date

explain.text:
• 考點：交期截止條件（同義替換）。
• 解析：Document 2 備註指出若要在 2 月 20 日前完成試車（趕上 3 月初稽核），採購單與訂金必須在 11 月 18 日前收到（purchase order and deposit must be received by November 18），選項 (D) "Finalize the order and initial payment by the specified cutoff date" 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(A) 皆挪用原文 "Kuroda Taiwan engineer"、"December 11"、"60-tool automatic tool changer"，但與達成交期無關。

questions.q: Which finding carried the most urgent severity rating?
options: SAF-01
SAF-02
SAF-03
SAF-04

explain.text:
• 考點：表格嚴重程度比較。
• 解析：Document 1 表格中僅 SAF-02 標示為 Critical（Immediate），最為緊急，選 (B)。

questions.q: When was Finding SAF-02 resolved?
options: On November 14
On November 13
It is still awaiting parts.
On November 12

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件日期推算。
• 解析：Document 1 記載巡檢日為 November 12；Document 2 指出在巡檢後兩小時內即修復 SAF-02（within two hours of the inspection），故為 11 月 12 日當天解決，選 (D)。

questions.q: What is currently true about Assembly Bay 4?
options: A new flexible duct was installed there yesterday afternoon.
Operations there remain suspended pending repair verification.
It will stay closed until the November 30 carpentry round.
Its fume extractor was transferred to the Paint Mixing Room.

explain.text:
• 考點：現況細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：Document 2 說明新軟管明早才到貨，Assembly Bay 4 在修復完成測試前必須保持停機掛牌（must remain tagged out of service until the repair is tested），選項 (B) "Operations there remain suspended pending repair verification." 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(C) 皆重複原文 "flexible duct"、"Paint Mixing Room"、"November 30 carpentry round"，但均與事實不符。

questions.q: Where can Maintenance obtain a replacement for fire extinguisher #14?
options: Inside the Paint Mixing Room next to drum #3
At Aisle 11 near the red zone gauge
From backup inventory kept by plant security
From the vendor delivering the flexible duct tomorrow

explain.text:
• 考點：領取地點細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：Document 2 指示從保全室的備品庫存更換 14 號滅火器（from our spare stock in the security office），選項 (C) "From backup inventory kept by plant security" 將 spare stock 換為 backup inventory、security office 換為 plant security。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D)(A) 皆重複原文 "Aisle 11"、"flexible duct"、"Paint Mixing Room / drum #3"，但並非備品存放處。

questions.q: What can be inferred about Finding SAF-04?
options: It was already closed within two hours of Mr. Gomez's walkthrough.
The repair is scheduled to finish prior to its target deadline.
It must be resolved before noon on November 13.
It requires ordering a replacement bench from an outside vendor.

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件日期推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：Document 1 記載 SAF-04 目標結案日為 Nov 30，Document 2（11 月 13 日寄出）說明該長椅維修將安排在「下週的例行木工巡檢（next week's routine carpentry round）」，即會在 11 月 30 日期限前完成，選項 (B) "The repair is scheduled to finish prior to its target deadline." 精準對應。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(C) 皆挪用原文 "two hours / Mr. Gomez"、"noon on November 13"，但張冠李戴至 SAF-04。

questions.q: What feature of the UT-400 makes it suitable for harsh outdoor shipyard environments?
options: Its sealed housing that resists moisture and particulate matter
Its 12-hour hot-swappable Li-ion battery pack
Its hard carrying case included in the $4,200 base price
Its ability to detect weld seams up to 5,000 mm in steel

explain.text:
• 考點：產品規格推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：Document 1 列出防護等級為 IP67 (dust-tight and waterproof)，適合戶外造船廠嚴苛環境，選項 (A) "Its sealed housing that resists moisture and particulate matter" 將 dust-tight and waterproof 改寫為 resists moisture and particulate matter。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(D) 皆為型錄上真實規格（12-hour battery、hard carrying case、5,000 mm），但非針對防塵防水戶外環境的特性。

questions.q: How much will Pacific Shipyard pay for the four UT-400 base units after the discount?

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件計算題。
• 解析：Document 1 原價 $4,200，訂購 3 台以上享 9 折（$3,780/台，Document 3 亦已確認）。4 台合計 $3,780 × 4 = $15,120，選 (A)。

questions.q: What will be the total cost of the optional accessories Sarah Chen requested?

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件配件計算題。
• 解析：Sarah 訂購 4 組高解析角度感測器（$480 × 4 = $1,920）與 2 組磁性爬行探頭座（$350 × 2 = $700），且配件不適用大量折扣，總計 $1,920 + $700 = $2,620，選 (C)。

questions.q: Which item will NOT arrive by November 25?
options: The two magnetic crawler probe holders
The four UT-400 base units
The four high-resolution angle sensors
The standard sensors

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件缺貨比對。
• 解析：Document 3 明確說明磁性爬行探頭座（magnetic crawler probe holders）暫時缺貨至 12 月 2 日，無法在 11 月 25 日前送達，選 (A)。

questions.q: What does Mark Vance offer to do regarding shipping?
options: Hold the Taipei depot stock until December 2 for one combined delivery
Ship the optional accessories from Kaohsiung to meet the November 25 deadline
Extend the 10% volume discount to the magnetic crawler holders
Dispatch in-stock items immediately and forward remaining pieces at no freight fee

explain.text:
• 考點：出貨方案細節（同義替換）。

• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(B) 皆重複原文 "Taipei depot / December 2"、"10% volume discount"、"Kaohsiung / November 25"，但扭曲方案內容。

Three assembly lines will be audited by the Supplier Quality Committee.
An equal share of coating business will be reassigned to a backup supplier.

explain.text:

Uneven oxide thickness caused by a newly hired quality engineer
A 60-day delay in installing a new digital power unit on Tank #2
